review_candidates.title: VP Operations & AI Systems
review_candidates.description: Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure. Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers. But we don't stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences , across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions. Our Solutions: → Actirise: the display tech designed for performance → FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes → Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks → Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution → Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology Behind Sparteo’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising. Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe: FT1000 ranking – Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025 The Europas – Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups Pixalate Ranking – #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo, we don’t settle, we act. We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results. We are data-obsessed: Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos. We think as one: Collective goals come before personal wins. We trade off: We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results. We solve problems: We own challenges and turn ideas into action. We say what we do: Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈 Your Job Your mission is to turn AI, tools and data into a scaling lever for every Sparteo department , on top of a coherent architecture that lasts. Our growth should no longer be proportional to our hiring. You are the AI and tooling partner of every business department (Sales, CSM, Supply and monetization, Marketing, Finance, Support) and the architect of the system that carries them : tools and internal apps, the AI platform and shared skills, knowledge usable by humans and agents, and the data that makes steering possible. You report to the Managing Director , work closely with the CEO , and lead a hands-on team of 4 , including our Scale & Optimization team. The approach, with each department: understand the real need → help formalise the process → design the right answer (tool, app, skill, agent, automation, dashboard) → deploy, with AI as the main lever → measure usage and gains. Your first projects From your first weeks, you build: you ship tools, agents and automations that run, not just recommendations. Audit ongoing projects, in particular ticketing: real usage, redundancies, convergence plan. Data stack evolution: recommendations on sources of truth, KPI definitions and business dashboards, with the Data team. Supply team support: make its critical processes reliable and automated, starting with Meetscale onboarding and supply chain checks. AI-native marketing: tooling, skills and agents designed around AI from day one, alongside our new CMO. AI-driven sales: study and pilot a fully AI-driven sales motion for one of our products. Alerting and monitoring: harden blocklist, IVT and revenue-drop alerts. AI platform & business systems Architect and govern our AI platform: Claude usage, MCPs, context sources, agent patterns, guardrails, with the Shared Services and Security teams. Own the shared skills and agents portfolio: design, testing, versioning, distribution, usage tracking, retirement. Train champions in each team. Design the target architecture of our business tools: one source of truth per piece of data, explicit flows, SaaS rationalisation, less shadow IT. Define and build internal apps when within the team's reach, scope them with Engineering otherwise. Own the knowledge base architecture, so documentation stays usable by humans and agents alike. Adoption & impact Lead change: sequence deployments, train, run the champions network, measure adoption and correct course. Measure what works: usage KPIs per team, skill and app, and real gains (time saved, volume absorbed, error rate, headcount / activity ratio), reported to the Managing Director and the CEO. Your profile for this job Must-have Significant experience as VP Operations, COO, Business Systems, Product Ops or transformation lead, ideally in a growing SaaS or tech company. A dual business and technical profile: you understand a CSM's work as well as the architecture of an MCP, and translate one into the other. Advanced, recent hands-on practice of LLMs and agents: prompts, skills, agents, MCP, output evaluation, production deployment. You can show us something you built that runs today. Architectural vision: you have already designed or converged a business tool stack and you document your decisions. Strong technical culture: APIs, data models, SQL, scripting, automation tools, application architecture and security basics. Data culture: KPIs, business data modelling, useful dashboards, alerting. You lead change without line authority, and you have managed a team before. Strong awareness of security and compliance (GDPR). Professional French and English. Nice-to-have Adtech, media or marketplace background. Experience deploying an AI platform at company scale. AI-powered marketing or sales experience. Advanced Notion administration. Your mind set to share our adventure 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists. 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically. 🏃‍♂️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you. 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis. Benefits & Work Environment 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo, we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London. 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment. 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones. 🚀 Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond. 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role. 🩺 Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for. At Sparteo, we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Ready to join Team Sparteo? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process! Here are the stages in our recruitment process Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset will be held with a member of our Talent Acquisition team. Analytical and business logic tests Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including your future manager Taking up references Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting.

Furthermore, this role will be expected to lead more complex analysis initiatives and influence senior stakeholders. What you will be doing: Business Insights & Decision Support Translate business questions, pain points and requirements into structured analytical thinking that support decision making. Responsibilities include: Analysing commercial performance across sales, margin and product portfolios Identifying trends, performance drivers and emerging risks Supporting leadership discussions with data-backed insights Producing structured analysis that informs commercial, operational and financial decisions Act as a trusted analyst by proposing solution options and trade-offs Contributing to scenario modelling and forecasting analysis where required. Business KPI Framework Support Support the establishment and management of the organisation’s enterprise KPIs. Responsibilities include: Working with business stakeholders to clarify KPI definitions Ensuring consistency of metric implementation across dashboards Supporting KPI documentation and governance processes Identifying inconsistencies in reporting logic and proposing improvements Helping ensure analytics outputs align with certified data definitions. Dashboard Development & Analytics Delivery Design and deliver analytics products that support operational and strategic decisionmaking. Responsibilities include: Developing and maintaining dashboards within approved BI platforms Applying strong data visualisation principles to improve usability Improving existing reports to increase clarity and adoption Reducing reliance on manual Excel-based reporting Supporting executive reporting through clear narrative and interpretation of data. Analytical Data Preparation Work with the Analytics Engineering and Data Engineering, Platform teams to prepare datasets suitable for analysis. Responsibilities include: Querying enterprise datasets using SQL Validating data accuracy and investigating anomalies Supporting improvements to data models and transformations Performing data profiling and quality checks Ensuring analytical outputs are based on consistent and reliable data. Commercial & Operational Analytics Provide analytical support across key business functions including Sales, Category, Marketing, Finance and Operations. Examples include: Sales performance and channel analysis Margin and pricing analysis Campaign effectiveness and marketing ROI Product portfolio performance Operational KPI monitoring. Experimentation & Advanced Analytics Support the organisation’s development of more advanced analytical capabilities. Responsibilities include: Designing and evaluating experiments and A/B tests Supporting forecasting and predictive modelling initiatives Exploring opportunities for automation and AI-assisted analytics Contributing to the evaluation of emerging analytics technologies. Stakeholder & Business Partnering Develop strong relationships with business stakeholders across the organisation. Responsibilities include: Partnering with Sales, Category, Finance, Marketing, Operations, Regional Business Units and IT teams Translating business requirements into analytical solutions Communicating insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences Supporting workshops and analytical discussions with business teams. What skills and experiences you’ll need to ace this job: Proven experience in data analytics or business intelligence, as a data analyst, business analyst, technical business analyst or similar role Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders using analytical insights Experience designing analytical frameworks or KPI structures Experience delivering end-to-end analytical projects Experience in FMCG, retail, marketplace or consumer-driven businesses is beneficial. If this role sounds like an exciting opportunity for you, please apply online. Any queries can be directed to James at jdavison@mayborngroup.com
